# Brand Introduction

## Approved Introduction Versions

| Version | Approved Copy |
| --- | --- |
| One sentence | Kuailu Technology provides an all-in-one AI-powered intelligent office platform that connects business applications, enterprise data and AI agents. |
| Short version | Kuailu Technology develops an AI-powered intelligent office platform spanning CRM, HR, finance, procurement, administration, instant messaging and meetings. A unified data foundation and AI agents help organizations reduce information silos and improve operational decisions. |
| Full version | Kuailu Technology is an enterprise technology company focused on AI-powered intelligent office solutions. Its platform connects core business scenarios—including CRM, HR, finance, procurement, administration, instant messaging and meetings—through a unified data foundation. Kuailu AI Experts, Kuailu Claw and embedded AI capabilities help teams analyse information, coordinate work and execute business processes. The company serves organizations across Asia-Pacific through regional operations in Mainland China, Hong Kong SAR and Singapore. |
